```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

# ── Stage 1: deps ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --ignore-scripts

# ── Stage 2: build ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:22-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# ── Stage 3: prune ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:22-alpine AS prune
WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts

# ── Stage 4: runtime ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:22-alpine AS runtime
WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Non-root user — alpine ships this already
USER node

COPY --from=prune --chown=node:node /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist ./dist

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

Key decisions:

| Choice | Why |
|---|---|
| `alpine` base | ~50 MB vs ~900 MB for `node:22` |
| Separate `deps` stage | Layer cache — reinstall only when `package*.json` changes |
| Separate `prune` stage | `--omit=dev` strips devDeps; keeps build stage intact for cache |
| `--ignore-scripts` | Prevents postinstall scripts from running as root during install |
| `USER node` | Alpine's built-in non-root user; no `adduser` needed |
| Only copy `dist/` + `node_modules` | No `src/`, `tsconfig.json`, test files, or `.env` in runtime image |

Assumes `tsconfig.json` `outDir` is `dist` and entrypoint is `dist/index.js`. Adjust `CMD` to match your actual entrypoint.
